8: ## 1. 目标与固定结论
9: 
10: 目标是在 BK7258 上运行一个 NuttX SMP 实例：物理 CPU1 和 CPU2 共同执行同一个
11: OpenVela `nuttx.bin`，目标 AP 核频率为 480 MHz。物理 CPU0 继续运行 Armino CP，
12: 并继续拥有全芯片电源、DPLL、核心/总线时钟、电压、PSRAM PHY、硬件 WDT 和
13: CPU1 电源生命周期。
14: 
15: 正式架构固定为：
16: 
17: | 物理核 | NuttX 编号 | 角色 | 目标频率 |
18: | --- | ---: | --- | ---: |
19: | CPU0 | 不可见 | Armino CP，电源/频率执行者 | 240 MHz（480 MHz档位下） |
20: | CPU1 | 0 | OpenVela AP primary、系统 tick、CP transport owner | 480 MHz |
21: | CPU2 | 1 | OpenVela AP secondary、通用 SMP 调度 | 480 MHz |
22: 
23: BK7258 的 `PM_CPU_FRQ_480M` 不是三核都运行 480 MHz。原厂档位意图是：
24: 
25: ```text
26: core source: 480 MHz
27: CPU0:       240 MHz
28: CPU1:       480 MHz
29: CPU2:       480 MHz
30: bus:        240 MHz
31: ```
32: 
33: 当前 HAL 已明确写入 480 MHz source、CPU0 `/2` 和 CPU1/CPU2 `/1`，但
34: `sys_hal_core_bus_clock_ctrl()` 虽接收 `ckdiv_bus`，实际只改 `CLK_DIV_REG0[3:0]`
35: 的 core divider，没有写 bit 6 的 bus divider。因此 CPU0/CPU1/CPU2 目标值有源码
36: 依据，bus 240 MHz 仍是必须通过寄存器和实测确认的目标，不能只凭档位注释验收。

40: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/include/modules/pm.h:346-353`

44: 必须同时接受以下结论：
45: 
46: 1. 不能只打开 `CONFIG_SMP`。CPU2 reset/vector、核 ID、每核中断栈、IPI、
47:    SMP atomic 和驱动并发都必须实现。
48: 2. 不能只把 AP `CONFIG_BK7258_CPU_FREQ_HZ` 改为 480 MHz。CP 是共享核心时钟的
49:    唯一执行者，必须在释放 CPU1 reset 前建立 480 MHz vote，并在 AP 停止后释放。
50: 3. 首版 480 MHz SMP 运行期间禁止 runtime DVFS。CPU1/CPU2 的核心时钟变化会直接
51:    改变 SysTick；没有 pre-change/post-change 协议和时间补偿时，运行中改频会破坏
52:    timeout、sleep、scheduler tick 和 heartbeat。
53: 4. `CONFIG_SYSTEM_TIME64=y` 是必需配置，不是可选优化。当前 32 位配置已经造成
54:    可重复的长期静置重启。
55: 5. CPU2 不需要独立镜像或分区。CPU1/CPU2 共享 `app1.bin`、地址空间和调度器；
56:    CPU2 只需要同一镜像内的 secondary boot vector。
57: 6. CPU2 启动失败时不得静默降级为单核。`CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS=2` 下必须 fail-stop，
58:    否则 NuttX per-CPU 和调度器状态不完整。
59: 7. 首版只支持普通 idle WFI。CP coordinated low-voltage、CPU1/CPU2 掉电、CPU2
60:    hotplug 和 runtime DVFS 必须在独立阶段完成，不得和首次 SMP bring-up 混合。

79: - `EXTERNAL_AP_BIN` 打包链和单个 `app1.bin`。
80: 
81: 当前还没有：
82: 
83: - `CONFIG_SMP=y`、CPU2 secondary entry、`up_cpu_start()`。
84: - 逻辑 CPU ID、每核中断栈、CPU2 私有 MPU/NVIC 初始化。
85: - AP 内部 channel 1/2 raw Mailbox IPI。
86: - 适合 BK7258 SRAM exclusive 限制的 NuttX atomic backend。
87: - CP 侧 OpenVela AP 480 MHz 生命周期 vote。
88: - OpenVela 双核 coordinated low-voltage 和恢复时间补偿。

90: ### 2.2 对旧版方案的修正
91: 
92: | 旧说法 | 当前结论 |
93: | --- | --- |
94: | “不改变 CPU0/CP 固件” | 错误。480 MHz 生命周期、CPU2 电源域和低压策略必须修改 CP。协议兼容保持不变不等于 CP 源码不改。 |
95: | “首版固定 120 MHz” | 已被实板否定。当前 CP 将共享核心时钟降至 60 MHz；正式目标改为 CP 保证的 480 MHz。 |
96: | “Mailbox IRQ 到 board late 才注册” | 已过时。当前 `arm_serialinit()` 初始化 logical transport、Mailbox UART，并启动 physical mailbox；SMP 应在此基础上增加 channel 2。 |
97: | “PSRAM allocator/PWC 是占位分支” | 已过时。当前 `bk7258_psram.c` 已建立独立 allocator 和 shutdown 状态机，`bk7258_pm_pwc.c` 已处理 power/query/recovery。SMP 仍需审计其跨核锁和对象生命周期。 |
98: | “当前功能不含 Wi-Fi” | 已过时。当前工作树已有 Wi-Fi IPC 代码和配置；首次 SMP 调试仍应关闭 Wi-Fi 以缩小故障面，之后恢复。 |
99: | “AP_SPINLOCK 是硬件 spinlock” | 不准确。它是为 exclusive monitor 与 DMA/Audio 并发约束保留的 SRAM 区；锁仍由 LDAXR/STXR 实现。 |
100: | “CPU2 可由 CP start_cpu2_core() 启动” | 对单镜像 NuttX SMP 不适用。CP 不知道运行时 secondary vector；CPU1 在 `up_cpu_start(1)` 中写 CPU2 vector 并释放 reset。 |
101: | “低压睡眠可沿用原 AP” | 不成立。原实现依赖 FreeRTOS SMP idle、AON WFI bits、tick 补偿和 mailbox yield；NuttX 必须重建等价状态机。 |
102: 
103: ## 3. 已确认的长期重启与频率缺陷
104: 
105: ### 3.1 32 位时间乘法溢出导致 heartbeat 永久阻塞
106: 
107: AP heartbeat worker 位于：
108: 
109: ```c
110: for (;;)
111:   {
112:     nxsig_usleep(2000000);
113:     bk7258_mbox_send_message(... IPC_CPU1_HEART_BEAT_INDICATION ...);
114:   }
115: ```
116: 
117: 来源：
118: 
119: - `contest/.../chips/bk7258/bk7258_pm_pwc.c:70-82`
120: 
121: 当前最终配置同时满足：
122: 
123: ```text
124: CONFIG_TIMER_ARCH=y
125: CONFIG_USEC_PER_TICK=1000
126: # CONFIG_SYSTEM_TIME64 is not set
127: ```
128: 
129: NuttX generic architecture timer 使用：
130: 
131: ```c
132: static uint64_t current_usec(void)
133: {
134:   ...
135:   return TICK2USEC(timebase) + (status.timeout - status.timeleft);
136: }
137: ```
138: 
139: `timebase` 是 32 位 `clock_t`，`TICK2USEC` 为：
140: 
141: ```c
142: #define TICK2USEC(tick) ((tick) * USEC_PER_TICK)
143: ```
144: 
145: `1000L` 在 32 位 ARM 上仍为 32 位，因此乘法在转换为 `uint64_t` 之前已经溢出。
146: 编译产物也显示只有低 32 位 `mla`，返回值高 32 位被置零。AP 时间会在：
147: 
148: ```text
149: 2^32 us = 4,294,967.296 ms AP time
150: ```
151: 
152: 提前跳回零，而不是在正常的 32 位 tick 边界回卷。跨界前创建的两秒 sleep deadline
153: 大于这个人为最大值，回卷后的时钟永远到不了 deadline，heartbeat 线程永久阻塞。
154: 
155: CP 的 heartbeat fallback timeout 为 6000 ms。实板多次日志均满足：
156: 
157: ```text
158: current - last_heartbeat = 6000 ms
159: Assert at: mb_ipc_task:298
160: ```
161: 
162: 所以重启是 CP 在 AP heartbeat 停止后执行的确定性断言，不是随机复位。
163: 
164: 必需修复：
165: 
166: ```text
167: CONFIG_SYSTEM_TIME64=y
168: ```
169: 
170: 不能只把 heartbeat 改成 busy wait、分段 sleep 或增大 CP timeout。这些只能隐藏一个
171: 调用者，Mailbox worker、semaphore timeout 和其他 watchdog deadline 仍会失效。
172: 
173: ### 3.2 CP 60 MHz 与 AP 120 MHz 配置不一致
174: 
175: 当前 AP SysTick 使用：
176: 
177: ```c
178: systick_initialize(true, CONFIG_BK7258_CPU_FREQ_HZ, -1);
179: ```
180: 
181: AP 配置是 120 MHz，但 CP 配置和初始化代码会执行：
182: 
183: ```text
184: CONFIG_CPU_DEFAULT_FREQ_60M=y
185: bk_pm_module_vote_cpu_freq(PM_DEV_ID_DEFAULT, PM_CPU_FRQ_60M)
186: ```
187: 
188: 而 60 MHz 档位同时影响 CPU0、CPU1、CPU2 和 bus。结果是 AP 以 120 MHz 计算的
189: 1 ms SysTick 实际约为 2 ms，2 秒 heartbeat 实际约为 4 秒。
190: 
191: 这也精确解释了重启为何发生在约 2 小时 23 分，而不是约 1 小时 11 分：
192: 
193: ```text
194: 4,294.967296 s * (120 / 60) = 8,589.934592 s
195: ```
196: 
197: 实板在约 `8,594.5 s` assert，差值位于最后一帧 heartbeat 到 6 秒 timeout 的窗口。
198: 
199: ### 3.3 CP heartbeat 配置符号错误
200: 
201: CP heartbeat 代码检查 `CONFIG_WDT_EN`，当前生成配置实际使用 `CONFIG_INT_WDT` 和
202: `CONFIG_INT_WDT_PERIOD_MS=8000`。所以最终固件走的是 `2000 * 3 = 6000 ms` fallback。
203: 
204: 应将 CP 条件改为实际 watchdog 配置符号，并明确 heartbeat timeout 策略。但即使改成
205: 8 秒，也不能替代 AP 时间和频率修复。
206: 
207: ## 4. 电源、频率与核生命周期所有权
208: 
209: ### 4.1 所有权表
210: 
211: | 资源 | 唯一执行者 | OpenVela AP 职责 |
212: | --- | --- | --- |
213: | DPLL/core source/core divider/bus divider | CPU0/CP PM | 只声明固定 480 MHz 契约并校验结果；bus divider 未验证前不得发布 ready |
214: | VDDD/VDDDIG 高压档 | CPU0/CP PM | 不直接写 analog/PMU 电压寄存器 |
215: | CPU1 power/reset/boot offset | CPU0/CP | 发送 ready/recovery，不能直接关闭自身 |
216: | CPU2 power domain | CPU0/CP | 请求域保持 ON；不得直接改 `CPU2_PWR_DW/HALT` 绕过 CP accounting |
217: | CPU2 reset/boot offset | CPU1/AP primary | `up_cpu_start(1)` 写 secondary vector 并释放 reset |
218: | CPU2 scheduler/idle/IPI | OpenVela SMP | 完整管理 |
219: | PSRAM PHY、电压、时钟、容量检测 | CPU0/CP | 通过 PWC vote；只管理 AP allocator |
220: | SysTick 和 NuttX monotonic time | CPU1/OpenVela | 固定频率下维护；低压阶段用 AON 时间补偿 |
221: | WDT 和 heartbeat assert | CPU0/CP | AP 持续发送 heartbeat，处理 transport 错误 |
222: 
223: 这里的 ID 属于两个不同命名空间：`PM_DEV_ID_CPU1` 是共享 frequency vote 表的 owner
224: slot，不是 CPU1 power-domain ID，也不存在 `PM_DEV_ID_CPU2` frequency slot。CPU1/CPU2
225: 电源必须分别使用 `PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU1`、`PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU2`。当前 power
226: enum 中 CPU1、APP、CPU2 的值依次为17、18、19；禁止根据公共头文件中的过时数字注释
227: 硬编码 ID。
228: 
229: ### 4.2 480 MHz 启动时序
230: 
231: CP 必须在释放 CPU1 reset 之前建立 480 MHz，不能等 AP 启动后再通过 PWC 改频：
232: 
233: ```text
234: CP OpenVela AP boot transaction
235:   -> sole owner写PM_DEV_ID_CPU1 = PM_CPU_FRQ_480M
236:   -> 验证owner slot、PM cache和实际clock/voltage寄存器
237:   -> 用语义化helper确认CPU2处于reset-hold
238:   -> 获取OpenVela CPU2 power-only hold并确认domain ON
239:   -> power CPU1 domain ON
240:   -> 按34-byte CRC physical到32-byte logical规则计算CPU1 boot offset
241:   -> 用已验证的语义化helper release CPU1 reset
242:   -> CPU1 OpenVela 按 480 MHz 初始化 SysTick
243:   -> nx_start()内部调用nx_smp_start()/up_cpu_start(1)
244:   -> CPU1 设置 CPU2 secondary vector并用语义化helper release reset
245:   -> CPU2 online和双向IPI自检
246:   -> 发送IPC power-up并启动heartbeat
247:   -> 发送PM_CPU1_BOOT_READY_CMD解除CP启动等待
248:   -> 请求并验证PSRAM PWC
249:   -> 成功后发布独立的最终AP/PSRAM-ready门禁
250: ```
251: 
252: `PM_CPU1_BOOT_READY_CMD` 必须先于PSRAM请求：当前CP从low-power worker启动CPU1并在同一
253: worker中等待boot-ready，PSRAM vote也由该worker处理；反向排序会造成双方互等。这里的
254: 最终ready是给上层allocator/driver的独立门禁，不能替换或延后现有boot-ready。
255: 
256: CP 侧建议增加显式配置 `CONFIG_OPENVELA_AP_480M`，只在外部 OpenVela AP 构建中启用，
257: 避免改变原厂 FreeRTOS AP 的默认行为。该配置下修改：
258: 
259: - `PM_DEV_ID_CPU1` 只有一个覆盖式 byte slot，不是引用计数。480 MHz vote 必须只有
260:   一个生命周期 owner；建议由新的 OpenVela boot transaction 在任何 CPU1/CPU2 power-on
261:   前写入。`user_app_main()` 只请求事务启动，`pm_module_bootup_cpu1()` 不得重复投同一 slot。
262: - `PM_DEV_ID_DEFAULT=60M` 可保留。PM 取所有 slot 最大值，AP online 时480M胜出；AP
263:   vote释放后回到60M是当前CP配置的正常策略。只有明确要求AP关闭后CP回到120M时，才
264:   条件跳过最终60M写入，该选择不是建立480M契约的必要条件。
265: - `bk_pm_current_max_cpu_freq_get()` 只是软件 cache。上电前必须同时校验
266:   `bk_pm_module_current_cpu_freq_get(PM_DEV_ID_CPU1)`、current max、core source、core
267:   divider、bus divider、CPU0/CPU1/CPU2 speed和VDDDIG；软件状态与寄存器不一致即失败。
268: - 新增 OpenVela CPU2 power-only hold API。它只做独立 owner accounting、控制
269:   `PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU2` 并等待power readback；不得调用 `start_cpu2_core()`、写
270:   CPU2 offset或release reset。现有boot-vote API会同时启动CPU2，不适用于单镜像NuttX。
271: - CPU1 boot继续复用 `get_partition_addr(1)` 的34-byte CRC physical到32-byte logical
272:   转换及SoC address处理，最终寄存器写入转换后地址的 `offset >> 8`，不得写raw partition
273:   start。
274: - 裸 `CPU1/2_SW_RST=0/1` 的HAL注释与原厂start/stop helper语义矛盾。实施时必须提供
275:   `cpu_hold_reset()`/`cpu_release_reset()`，通过run-status和实板启动试验确定极性并修正
276:   注释；方案和日志不能把未经验证的裸值直接命名为assert/release。
277: - `cp/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/Kconfig`：增加 `CONFIG_OPENVELA_AP_480M` bool 选项，
278:   默认关闭；只在 `projects/app_ab/cp/config/bk7258/config` 中由 OpenVela 构建启用。
279: 
280: 所有 CP 源码修改必须同时在比赛仓 `external/bk_avdk_smp/` 权威副本中保留，并更新
281: `external/bk_avdk_smp/README.md` 的覆盖文件表和同步命令，不能只修改
282: `bk_avdk_smp` 构建树。同步方法见该 README 第 2 节。
283: 
284: 按本方案实施时，权威覆盖至少会新增实际修改到的以下路径；若实现落在其他文件，也必须

289: projects/app_ab/cp/config/bk7258/config

291: cp/components/bk_startup/system_main.c
292: cp/include/driver/pwr_clk.h
293: cp/middleware/driver/common/driver.c
294: cp/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/Kconfig
295: cp/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/pwr_clk.c
296: cp/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/low_pwr_core.c
297: cp/middleware/soc/bk7258/hal/sys_hal.c

301: 其中 `common/driver.c`、`pwr_clk.c` 和heartbeat文件已在当前镜像中；其余文件只有发生
302: 修改时才新增。每次构建前，README列出的全部覆盖文件与目标工作树必须逐字节 `cmp -s`

305: OpenVela boot transaction 必须返回明确错误，不能沿用当前始终返回 `BK_OK` 的
306: boot-vote外层接口。首次失败即进入按stage反向释放的rollback；删除当前CPU1 timeout时

310: 原厂实现根据当前档和目标档选择high-to-low或low-to-high路径，然后直接执行目标档，
311: 不会遍历中间档位。升频目标分支先写电压再切时钟，降频目标分支先切时钟再写电压。
312: 普通480M分支目标VDDDIG为0.95 V；VDDD 1.05 V helper仅在 `CONFIG_RX_OPTIMIZE` 启用时

315: - `cp/components/bk_pm/pm.c:2218-2283`
316: - `cp/middleware/driver/sys_ctrl/sys_ps_driver.c:243-288`
317: - `cp/middleware/soc/bk7258/hal/sys_hal.c:571-709`

331: ### 4.3 运行期频率规则
332: 
333: 首版运行期规则只有一条：AP online 时 `PM_DEV_ID_CPU1` 始终 vote 480 MHz。
334: 
335: - CP 默认60 MHz vote可以保留；PM取所有module slot的最大值，AP生命周期内唯一的480M
336:   slot会把共享时钟保持在480 MHz。
337: - AP 不发送 `PM_CPU_FREQ_CTRL_CMD` 降频。
338: - 其他 CP/AP module 可以投票，但不能把最大值降到 480 MHz以下。
339: - CP 应提供诊断查询，至少输出 current max vote、全部vote owner、core source、core/bus
340:   divider、CPU0/CPU1/CPU2 speed、VDDD/VDDDIG、CPU1/CPU2 power/reset和PSRAM owner状态。
341: - `PM_CPU_FRQ_480M` 被 `CONFIG_CLK_FORCE_MAX_CPU_FREQ_320M` 截断时必须判为启动失败，
342:   不能继续用 480 MHz SysTick配置运行。
343: 
344: 保留 `PM_GET_PM_DATA_CMD` 命令值 `0xc`，同步扩展AP/CP的
345: `pm_ap_get_cp_data_type_e`，增加只读current-frequency与divider查询类型。扩展必须同时
346: 更新双方header和source override，不能单边复用已有enum数值。
347: 
348: ### 4.4 关闭与故障回滚
349: 
350: 正常关闭或 AP recovery 的顺序必须是：
351: 
352: ```text
353: AP primary停止新任务和外设提交
354:   -> quiesce PSRAM/DMA/Mailbox UART
355:   -> 调度CPU2执行stop callback
356:   -> 屏蔽CPU2普通IRQ和IPI
357:   -> CPU2进入确认的park/WFI状态
358:   -> CPU1用语义化helper将CPU2置reset并确认不再执行
359:   -> AP释放自己的PSRAM PWC owner并等待CP ACK
360:   -> AP向CP回复recovery-ready
361:   -> CP确认CPU2 reset，释放power-only hold并确认CPU2 domain OFF
362:   -> CP停止/reset CPU1并确认CPU1 domain OFF
363:   -> CP以PM_CPU_FRQ_DEFAULT释放PM_DEV_ID_CPU1 slot
364:   -> CP按CPU档位和剩余PSRAM owner重新计算VDDDIG
365: ```
366: 
367: 当前 CP shutdown 代码仅在特定低压配置下才停止 CPU2，而且顺序是先停止 CPU1、后停止
368: CPU2。OpenVela SMP 模式必须改成上述顺序。CPU2仍在执行共享NuttX状态时，CP不能
369: 直接关闭CPU2 power；CPU1已停止后也不能再依赖CPU1去park CPU2。
370: 
371: 所有失败必须达到相同后置条件，但不能强制走同一callback路径：CPU1/CPU2不执行、只对
372: 本事务已获取的CPU2/CPU1 domain、OpenVela PSRAM owner和480M slot按反序释放。
373: 
374: - 480M/readback失败发生在CPU1 release前：CP直接撤销已获取资源，不等待AP。
375: - CPU1 boot超时：CP强制CPU1/CPU2 reset并关闭domain，不等待AP recovery。
376: - CPU2 online超时：CPU1若仍可信就强制CPU2 reset，不能依赖未online的stop callback。
377: - 只有正常recovery才使用完整AP quiesce、park和ready握手。
378: 
379: ## 5. 睡眠与低功耗分阶段方案
380: 
381: ### 5.1 阶段 P0：普通 WFI，禁止 coordinated low-voltage
382: 
383: 首次 SMP 和 480 MHz 验收只启用 per-core 普通 WFI：
384: 
385: - 增加BK7258 `up_idle()`；当前公共ARM `up_idle()`中的WFI被 `#if 0` 禁用，不能把
386:   “空闲任务在运行”误判为已经WFI。chip hook必须清 `SCB_SCR_SLEEPDEEP`，执行
387:   `DSB; WFI; ISB`，且不设置coordinated low-voltage ready bit。
388: - CP在每次OpenVela启动和recovery时显式调用
389:   `bk_pm_module_vote_sleep_ctrl(PM_SLEEP_MODULE_NAME_CPU1, 0, 0)` 并检查 `BK_OK`。
390:   state 0表示AP active/not-ready，因此全芯片low-voltage条件不成立。
391: - 保持 `CONFIG_PM_AP_POWERDOWN_WHEN_LV` 关闭。
392: - 不支持 CPU1/CPU2 power-down、retention、CPU2 hotplug 或 tickless。
393: - heartbeat、Mailbox 和 SysTick 在普通 WFI 下仍可唤醒 CPU1。
394: 
395: CP 的 `PM_ENTER_LOW_VOL_MODULES_CONFIG` 包含 `PM_SLEEP_MODULE_NAME_CPU1`。启动 OpenVela
396: AP 时应显式写exit-sleep，不能依赖BSS初值；PM初始化实际上会把CPU1置为enter-sleep，
397: 而当前清除代码又受已关闭的 `CONFIG_PM_AP_POWERDOWN_WHEN_LV` 条件控制。OpenVela必须
398: 独立执行上述调用，保证未实现低压协议时CP只能进入normal sleep。
399: 
400: ### 5.2 阶段 P1：双核 coordinated low-voltage
401: 
402: 只有 P0 的 24 小时稳定性通过后，才能实现原厂 AP 的等价低压协议。原厂事实为：
403: 
404: - CP 要求 CPU1 和 CPU2 都进入 WFI，并检查 AON PMU 的
405:   `cp1_enter_wfi_state`、`cp2_enter_wfi_state`。
406: - AP 两个核分别屏蔽普通 IRQ，只保留本核 Mailbox wakeup。
407: - CP 保存并切换核心/Flash 时钟，恢复 DPLL 后再唤醒 AP。
408: - 原 AP 依赖 FreeRTOS SMP idle 和 `vPortYieldCore()`；这些调用不能直接移植到 NuttX。
409: 
410: NuttX实现必须复用现有SMP PM框架，而不是另建平行barrier：
411: 
412: 1. 启用 `CONFIG_PM=y`、选定governor、`CONFIG_PM_NDOMAINS=3` 和
413:    `CONFIG_PM_SMP_LAST_CPU_INDEX=0`；这里的0是NuttX logical CPU0/物理CPU1，不是CP。
414: 2. BK7258 `up_idle()` 调用 `pm_idle(handler)`；驱动通过 `pm_register()` 注册
415:    `struct pm_callback_s` prepare/notify callback。
416: 3. logical CPU0作为last CPU发起全局transition，禁止新任务迁移、DMA和mailbox
417:    transaction；两核运行per-CPU prepare并保存本核NVIC/SysTick状态。
418: 4. CPU2设置 `cp2_enter_wfi_state` 后进入WFI；CPU1确认CPU2已就绪。
419: 5. CPU1停止SysTick，设置 `cp1_enter_wfi_state`，通过既有sleep vote允许CP进入低压。
420: 6. CP只在两个AON WFI bit、AP sleep/clock vote和mailbox idle都满足后切换低压。
421: 7. CP恢复DPLL、经readback验证的480 MHz档位和bus后，通过Mailbox唤醒AP。
422: 8. CPU1读取AON elapsed time，恢复monotonic time和SysTick；再唤醒CPU2。
423: 9. 两核恢复NVIC和驱动callback，`pm_idle()`完成restore并恢复heartbeat。
424: 
425: 低压时间基准不能继续完全依赖core-clock SysTick。增加BK7258 strong
426: `up_timer_gettick()`/`up_timer_gettime()`，以AON RTC构建64位单调epoch；当前原厂启用
427: 64-bit AON counter，应使用稳定的low/high重读算法，不需要软件扩展32-bit wrap。必须由
428: CP契约确认32 kHz源是32000还是32768 Hz，并用64位算术换算、校准和验证回卷单调性。
429: 
430: 时间读取本身不是唤醒源。P1必须提供下一NuttX deadline的AON/CP wake：推荐启用
431: `CONFIG_SCHED_TICKLESS=y`，实现完整的 `up_timer_tick_cancel()`/
432: `up_timer_tick_start()` 或 `up_alarm_cancel()`/`up_alarm_start()` AON compare backend。
433: 若暂时保持periodic语义，则必须编程AON wake不晚于下一1 ms tick，收益有限。恢复时先
434: 确认clock稳定，再重启SysTick；解除PM barrier前必须让logical CPU0至少执行一次timer
435: processing，使低压期间到期的sleep和watchdog立即得到处理。
436: 
437: 在 AON-backed monotonic time、双核 barrier和驱动 PM callback完成前，禁止打开 P1。
438: 
439: ### 5.3 Deep sleep
440: 
441: Deep sleep定义为 AP 上下文丢失后的完整重启，不是 NuttX suspend-to-RAM：
442: 
443: - CPU1/CPU2、NuttX heap、scheduler、Mailbox transport和PSRAM对象均视为丢失。
444: - CP/bootloader重新启动 CPU1，CPU1重新启动 CPU2。
445: - PSRAM generation必须变化，旧对象不可复用。
446: - 不承诺从原 PC/任务现场继续运行。
447: 
448: ## 6. NuttX SMP 芯片层实现
449: 
450: ### 6.1 配置硬门禁
451: 
452: AP defconfig目标配置：
453: 
454: ```text
455: CONFIG_ARCH_HAVE_MULTICPU=y
456: CONFIG_SMP=y
457: CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS=2
458: CONFIG_SMP_DEFAULT_CPUSET=0x3
459: CONFIG_ARCH_INTERRUPTSTACK=2048
460: CONFIG_SYSTEM_TIME64=y
461: CONFIG_TIMER_ARCH=y
462: CONFIG_ARMV8M_SYSTICK=y
463: CONFIG_USEC_PER_TICK=1000
464: CONFIG_BK7258_CPU_FREQ_HZ=480000000
465: # CONFIG_SCHED_TICKLESS is not set
466: ```
467: 
468: 上述是S0-S4/P0配置。P1另增加：
469: 
470: ```text
471: CONFIG_PM=y
472: CONFIG_PM_NDOMAINS=3
473: CONFIG_PM_SMP_LAST_CPU_INDEX=0
474: CONFIG_PM_GOVERNOR_GREEDY=y
475: CONFIG_PM_GOVERNOR_EXPLICIT_RELAX=0

479: `ARCH_CHIP_BK7258` 增加：
480: 
481: ```kconfig

483: select ARCH_IDLE_CUSTOM
484: select LIBC_ATOMIC_HWSPINLOCK if SMP

486: 
487: `ARCH_IDLE_CUSTOM` 必须同时对Make和CMake生效，使公共 `arm_idle.c` 不进入构建；否则
488: `bk7258_idle.c` 与公共实现会重复定义 `up_idle()`。
489: 
490: `board/beken/chips/bk7258/Kconfig:15-17` 的 `CONFIG_BK7258_CPU_FREQ_HZ` 默认值从
491: `120000000` 改为 `480000000`。`bk7258_timerisr.c:16` 直接引用该宏传递给
492: `systick_initialize()`，无需额外修改 timerisr 源码。
493: 
494: 最终 `.config` 必须确认 `clock_t` 为64位、toolchain atomic没有绕过 BK7258 backend、
495: CPU数为2。禁止只修改生成的 `.config`；必须修改项目 defconfig并执行 distclean。

532: ### 6.3 CPU ID
533: 
534: 原厂 AP 使用每核私有 DTCM地址 `0x20000000` 保存 AP逻辑核 ID。OpenVela采用：
535: 
536: ```text
537: 物理CPU1私有 0x20000000 = NuttX CPU0
538: 物理CPU2私有 0x20000000 = NuttX CPU1
539: ```
540: 
541: `up_cpu_index()` 直接读取该word。primary在任何 per-CPU/NuttX atomic调用前写0；
542: secondary在任何NuttX API前写1。必须实板验证两核看到的是私有实例，不是共享word。
543: 
544: ### 6.4 内存、secondary vector和栈
545: 
546: 分区保持：
547: 
548: ```text
549: AP_SPINLOCK  0x28000000..0x2800ffff
550: AP_RAM       0x28010000..0x28063fff
551: CP_RAM       0x28064000..0x2809f6ff
552: PWR_MNG      0x2809f700..0x2809f7ff
553: SWAP         0x2809f800..0x2809ffff
554: ```
555: 
556: CPU2不增加Flash/RAM分区。链接脚本增加：
557: 
558: - `SPINLOCK` MEMORY，绝不加入heap。
559: - 512字节对齐的 `.bk_secondary_vectors`。
560: - 只用于reset早期的CPU2 bootstrap stack。
561: - 两份静态 interrupt stack，或等价的每核固定中断栈区域。
562: - 全部边界和对齐 `ASSERT`。
563: 
564: secondary vector：
565: 
566: ```text
567: word 0: CPU2 bootstrap MSP top
568: word 1: bk7258_secondary_start | 1
569: ```
570: 
571: CPU2 boot offset寄存器只保存地址高24位，至少要求256字节对齐；统一采用512字节以
572: 满足VTOR约束。secondary vector不包含primary image offset `0x100` 的BK legacy magic。
573: 
574: `up_cpu_idlestack()` 应像RP2040一样调用 `up_create_stack()`，初始化logical CPU1 idle
575: TCB。还必须分配 `CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS * INTSTACK_SIZE` 对齐空间并实现
576: `uintptr_t up_get_intstackbase(int cpu)`；公共ARM实现只覆盖UP构建，ARMv8-M任务初始状态
577: 会调用该hook。CPU2 reset后先用bootstrap MSP；进入NuttX前将PSP切到idle TCB stack
578: top，调用 `arm_initialize_stack()` 安装本核MSP/MSPLIM interrupt stack。两个核不得共用
579: MSP。
580: 
581: ### 6.5 CPU2启动
582: 
583: `up_cpu_start(1)`：
584: 
585: ```text
586: 校验cpu==1且当前为logical CPU0
587:   -> 确认CP的OpenVela CPU2 power-only hold和domain readback均为ON
588:   -> 确认480 MHz契约和channel 2已配置
589:   -> 发布idle PSP、interrupt MSP、runtime VTOR
590:   -> 清boot stage/online flag，DMB/DSB
591:   -> CPU2保持reset时清route/pending
592:   -> CPU2_RXEVT_SEL=1
593:   -> CPU2_OFFSET=secondary_vector>>8
594:   -> cpu2_release_reset()（极性已由run-status/实板验证）
595:   -> 有界等待online和双向IPI自检
596: ```
597: 
598: 超时建议500 ms，输出CPU2 control、run status、route、NVIC、Mailbox channel 2、boot
599: stage和当前频率readback，然后panic。不能只返回错误后继续 `nx_bringup()`。
600: 
601: `bk7258_secondary_start()` 只初始化每核私有状态：
602: 
603: - logical ID、FPU CP10/11和barrier。
604: - 与primary一致的SAU/MPU/VTOR。
605: - CPU2私有NVIC enable/pending/priority。
606: - CPU2 Mailbox route和IRQ79。
607: - PSP/MSP/stack limit。
608: - release-ordered online flag、可选的 `sched_note_cpu_started(this_task())`、
609:   `nx_idle_trampoline()`。
610: 
611: primary以acquire语义等待online flag。`sched_note_cpu_started()`只是可选trace，在note
612: driver未启用时为空，不能承担online handshake。
613: 
614: secondary禁止复制 `.data`、清 `.bss`、初始化heap/PSRAM/driver、调用 `nx_start()`、
615: 初始化第二个SysTick或重置全局Mailbox FIFO。
616: 
617: ### 6.6 每核MPU/NVIC
618: 
619: MPU、SAU、NVIC、VTOR、SysTick和FPU控制均为每核私有。CPU2必须安装与CPU1相同的：
620: 
621: - AP Flash RO/X。
622: - AP RAM RW/XN/shareable。
623: - `AP_SPINLOCK` RW/XN/non-cacheable/shareable。
624: - CP共享窗口和Mailbox UART override。
625: - PSRAM 16 MiB RW/XN/non-cacheable。
626: - peripheral Device/XN。
627: 
628: 当前 CPU1 使用7个 MPU region；增加 AP_SPINLOCK 后至少需要8个，启动时继续读
629: `MPU_TYPE.DREGION`并 fail-stop。CPU2不能重复probe或初始化PSRAM allocator。
630: 
631: 全局NuttX IRQ table只由primary初始化一次。CPU2只初始化私有NVIC和CPU2 route：
632: 
633: ```text
634: CPU1 IRQ EN0/EN1: 0x44010088 / 0x4401008c
635: CPU2 IRQ EN0/EN1: 0x44010090 / 0x44010094
636: ```
637: 
638: 首版只有CPU2 Mailbox IPI路由到CPU2。GPIO、PWM、I2C、QSPI、camera、Wi-Fi和其他
639: 有状态外设仍由logical CPU0 owner。
640: 
641: ## 7. Mailbox IPI与CP transport共存
642: 
643: ### 7.1 物理channel
644: 
645: | channel | owner | FIFO |
646: | ---: | --- | --- |
647: | 0 | CPU0/CP | start 0, length 2 |
648: | 1 | CPU1/AP primary | start 2, length 3 |
649: | 2 | CPU2/AP secondary | start 5, length 3 |
650: 
651: 沿用原厂消息分类：
652: 
653: ```text
654: data[1] != 0: pointer + length envelope，进入CP/AP logical transport
655: data[1] == 0: AP内部raw command，进入SMP IPI handler
656: ```
657: 
658: CPU2不处理CP PWC、heartbeat、Wi-Fi或Mailbox UART envelope。CP transport始终由
659: logical CPU0负责。
660: 
661: ### 7.2 当前初始化路径的改造
662: 
663: 当前 physical Mailbox 已在 `arm_serialinit()` 中经：
664: 
665: ```text
666: bk7258_mailbox_init()
667: bk7258_mb_uart_init()
668: bk7258_mailbox_start()
669: ```
670: 
671: 启动。这发生在 `nx_smp_start()` 之前，生命周期适合SMP。改造要求：
672: 
673: 1. primary physical start一次性配置channel 1和2 FIFO，不能在CPU2 online后soft reset。
674: 2. 全局 `irq_attach(79, ...)` 只执行一次；CPU2复用共享NuttX IRQ handler table，但启用
675:    自己的route和私有NVIC line 63。
676: 3. ISR按 `up_cpu_index()` 选择本核physical channel。
677: 4. channel 1可处理CP envelope和raw IPI；channel 2只接受raw IPI。
678: 5. shared transport状态从仅 `up_irq_save()` 改为SMP spinlock，或严格固定到CPU0。
679: 
680: ### 7.3 NuttX SMP hooks
681: 
682: 实现：
683: 
684: ```c
685: int up_send_smp_sched(int cpu);
686: void up_send_smp_call(cpu_set_t cpuset);
687: ```
688: 
689: raw command采用pending bitmap合并 `SCHED`、`CALL`和 `PM`。发送前DMB，ISR读取并清
690: pending后DMB，然后调用：
691: 
692: ```c
693: nxsched_smp_call_handler(irq, context, arg);
694: nxsched_process_delivered(this_cpu());
695: ```
696: 
697: FIFO full不能静默丢失。采用“shared pending bit + kick”语义：消息只负责唤醒，真实
698: 工作由pending bit保持；如果目标已有未处理kick，不重复占FIFO。发送失败需要有界重试、
699: 计数和fatal门限，禁止持有目标ISR需要的spinlock时无限等待。
700: 
701: ## 8. Atomic、spinlock和共享驱动
702: 
703: ### 8.1 BK7258约束
704: 
705: 原厂注释明确：BK7258 AP SMP只有两个exclusive monitor；两个CPU同时对普通SRAM做
706: exclusive访问时，第三方DMA/Audio写SRAM可能无提示失败。因此原厂把所有spinlock对象
707: 集中在 `AP_SPINLOCK` 特殊SRAM区。
708: 
709: `AP_SPINLOCK`不是寄存器型硬件spinlock。首版使用一个位于该区的software gate，
710: 通过LDAXR/STXR仲裁NuttX `atomic_*` 和libc out-of-line atomic helper：
711: 
712: ```text
713: CONFIG_LIBC_ATOMIC_HWSPINLOCK=y
714: g_atomic_hwspinlock -> struct hwspinlock_dev_s -> BK7258 software gate
715: ```
716: 
717: gate owner使用 `logical_cpu + 1`，0表示free，避免CPU0 owner和free混淆。trylock使用
718: acquire exclusive，unlock使用release store、DSB和SEV。primary在进入 `nx_start()` 前
719: 初始化gate；CPU2启动后禁止再次清零。
720: 
721: 这不会自动拦截编译器内联 `__atomic_*`、`__sync_*` 或手写exclusive loop。SMP源码禁止
722: 直接使用这些路径，构建时反汇编全部SMP对象，除approved gate外发现LDREX/STREX或
723: LDAXR/STXR循环即失败。只有DMA/Audio/exclusive压力通过后才能评估更细粒度方案。
724: 
725: ### 8.2 驱动收敛
726: 
727: 首版将以下worker和IRQ固定到logical CPU0：
728: 
729: - Mailbox transport/UART/syslog/PWC/heartbeat。
730: - Wi-Fi、camera、QSPI、DMA和媒体worker。
731: - GPIO、button/motor、PWM、I2C。
732: - 所有未完成SMP审计的board driver。
733: 
734: worker入口在访问任何driver状态前先构造 `CPU_ZERO/CPU_SET(0)` mask，并调用
735: `sched_setaffinity(0, sizeof(cpu_set_t), &cpuset)`；成功后才通知creator ready。creator
736: 等待该ready，affinity失败则driver bring-up失败。不能在 `kthread_create()` 返回后才pin，
737: 因为worker可能已经运行。
738: 
739: 即使worker固定CPU0，CPU2任务仍可能调用公共API。以下共享状态必须使用
740: `spin_lock_irqsave()` 或mutex：
741: 
742: - Mailbox active transaction、ACK pool、recovery epoch和ring index。
743: - syslog/serial TX/RX ring。
744: - GPIO/PWM/I2C寄存器RMW。
745: - PSRAM allocator状态、allocation counters和generation。
746: - Wi-Fi command/data slot和pbuf ownership。
747: 
748: ISR共享短状态使用spinlock；会等待ACK、semaphore、内存或格式化日志的路径使用mutex，
749: 禁止在spinlock内sleep。
750: 
751: ## 9. 系统tick、heartbeat与时间正确性
752: 
753: 首版只有logical CPU0启动SysTick。CPU2不得调用 `up_timer_initialize()`，否则系统时间
754: 和RR accounting加倍。CPU0每tick调用NuttX timer处理，调度器通过IPI要求CPU2切换。
755: 
756: 必须满足：
757: 
758: - `CONFIG_SYSTEM_TIME64=y`。
759: - CPU1实际频率和 `CONFIG_BK7258_CPU_FREQ_HZ=480000000` 一致。
760: - 60秒wall clock测试误差在晶振/调度允许范围内，不能出现2倍或1/2倍。
761: - heartbeat实际周期约2秒，不是4秒。
762: - heartbeat发送返回值必须检查并统计 `-EBUSY`、`-ENOLINK`、timeout。
763: - CP heartbeat使用实际 `CONFIG_INT_WDT` 配置；timeout至少容纳调度抖动和一次transport
764:   recovery，但不能用增大timeout掩盖lost heartbeat。
765: 
766: 长期测试必须跨越旧故障边界：至少运行3小时；正式验收运行24小时。还应通过调试构建
767: 把timer timebase置于旧的 `UINT32_MAX / 1000` 边界前，快速验证sleep跨界。
768: 
769: ## 10. 分阶段实施
770: 
771: ### S0：先修复单核时间和480 MHz契约
772: 
773: 1. AP defconfig 增加 `CONFIG_SYSTEM_TIME64=y`，保持单核 `CONFIG_SMP` 关闭。
774: 2. AP `Kconfig` 将 `CONFIG_BK7258_CPU_FREQ_HZ` 默认值改为 `480000000`。
775: 3. CP增加 `CONFIG_OPENVELA_AP_480M` 和单一boot transaction owner；在任何AP power-on
776:    前写 `PM_DEV_ID_CPU1=PM_CPU_FRQ_480M`，保留默认60M slot，并显式写CPU1 exit-sleep。
777: 4. 修复DVFS子函数错误传播、bus divider写入/readback和CPU/PSRAM联合VDDDIG下限；把CP
778:    boot PSRAM和OpenVela PWC纳入独立owner accounting并透传真实初始化错误。
779: 5. CP 修正 `mb_ipc_heartbeat.c` 的 watchdog 配置符号从 `CONFIG_WDT_EN` 改为实际
780:    `CONFIG_INT_WDT`，使 timeout 正确反映 `CONFIG_INT_WDT_PERIOD_MS`。
781: 6. 增加CP全部frequency owner、source/divider/speed/voltage/power/PSRAM readback诊断。
782: 7. AP heartbeat worker 检查 `bk7258_mbox_send_message()` 返回值，记录 `-EBUSY`、
783:    `-ENOLINK` 和 transport timeout 计数。
784: 
785: 退出条件：20次冷启动、60秒时间校准、3小时静置无heartbeat timeout；PM slot/cache和
786: 实际寄存器一致，CPU0=240 MHz、CPU1=480 MHz、CPU2 speed字段为480 MHz目标，bus经
787: divider readback和外部测量确认为240 MHz，无320M clamp；PSRAM ON/OFF故障注入不会发布
788: 虚假ready或把VDDDIG降到有效owner要求以下。
789: 
790: ### S1：SMP编译与内存骨架
791: 
792: 1. 先增加CPU ID、每核interrupt stack、`up_get_intstackbase()` 和secondary idle stack，
793:    并提供可链接的 `up_cpu_start()` fail-stop占位及 `up_send_smp_sched()`/
794:    `up_send_smp_call()` 占位，再打开SMP配置。
795: 2. 增加SPINLOCK MEMORY和atomic backend。
796: 3. 增加secondary vector和链接断言，暂不release CPU2。
797: 4. 增加P0 `up_idle()` 普通WFI；两核MPU表增加AP_SPINLOCK和相同PSRAM属性。
798: 
799: 退出条件：clean build通过但该产物不启动；map、vector、stack、gate和heap边界全部正确；
800: 反汇编确认exclusive loop只存在于approved gate，P0 idle object确实包含 `DSB/WFI/ISB`。
801: S2/S3分别替换上述fail-stop和IPI占位实现后才允许烧录启动。
802: 
803: ### S2：CPU2启动到idle
804: 
805: 1. CP通过OpenVela power-only hold在AP生命周期内保持CPU2 domain ON，并在handoff前
806:    保持经验证的reset状态；CP不调用原厂 `start_cpu2_core()`。
807: 2. AP实现语义化CPU2 reset helper、private arch init、stack切换和release/acquire online
808:    handshake，且不写CPU2 power-domain控制位。
809: 3. CPU2只运行NuttX idle，不路由普通外设。
810: 
811: 退出条件：100次冷启动，CPU2每次500 ms内online；任何失败都fail-stop且有寄存器诊断。
812: 
813: ### S3：IPI与调度
814: 
815: 1. 配置channel 2 FIFO和per-core IRQ79。
816: 2. 实现pending-bit raw IPI、`up_send_smp_sched/call`。
817: 3. 完成双向call、task migration、semaphore/mutex和atomic压力。
818: 
819: 退出条件：两核100%负载1小时，无lost IPI、死锁、counter mismatch和heartbeat timeout。
820: 
821: ### S4：恢复驱动
822: 
823: 1. worker/IRQ固定CPU0。
824: 2. 审计Mailbox、syslog、GPIO/PWM/I2C、PSRAM、Wi-Fi和camera共享状态。
825: 3. 依次恢复console、PWC/heartbeat、PSRAM、GPIO/PWM、Wi-Fi和camera。
826: 
827: 退出条件：单核已有功能全部回归，CPU2压力不影响CP transport和外设owner。
828: 
829: ### P1：低压睡眠
830: 
831: 1. 启用NuttX PM SMP框架、三个domain、logical CPU0 last-CPU和driver callback。
832: 2. 实现AON-backed 64位monotonic time及tickless AON compare/deadline wake backend。
833: 3. 在 `pm_idle(handler)` 内实现双核AON WFI bit和CP sleep vote协议。
834: 4. CP只在AP双方确认后进入low-voltage，寄存器确认恢复480 MHz/bus后再唤醒AP。
835: 5. 完成expired timer处理、heartbeat宽限和Mailbox恢复。
836: 
837: 退出条件：10000次低压进出、短/长timer deadline、RTC/GPIO wakeup、双核负载与故障
838: 注入全部通过；sleep/watchdog不晚触发，monotonic time不倒退。

905: ## 12. 实板验证矩阵
906: 
907: | 测试 | 方法 | 通过标准 |
908: | --- | --- | --- |
909: | 480 MHz契约 | CP读取全部vote、source、core/bus divider、三个CPU speed、VDDD/VDDDIG | slot/cache/寄存器一致；CPU0=240、AP=480、bus实测240；无320M clamp |
910: | wall clock | 对比外部计时60秒/1小时 | 无2倍或1/2倍走时 |
911: | heartbeat | 记录1000个间隔 | 约2秒，发送失败有统计，无CP timeout |
912: | 旧回卷边界 | debug seed + 3小时静置 | sleep继续唤醒，无时间倒退和assert |
913: | CPU ID | affinity任务读取 `sched_getcpu()` | 分别稳定为0、1 |
914: | CPU2启动 | 100次冷启动 | 全部500 ms内online |
915: | 双向IPI | CPU0->CPU1和CPU1->CPU0 | callback CPU和次数正确，无lost kick |
916: | task migration | mask 0x3计算任务 | 可迁移且状态完整 |
917: | atomic | 两核各加100万次 | 精确200万 |
918: | DMA+atomic | DMA写普通SRAM并发lock压力 | 无silent DMA write loss |
919: | interrupt stack | 中断嵌套和stack coloration | 两核MSP不重叠、不越界 |
920: | PSRAM | owner/error/电压故障注入及两核并发alloc/free | init失败不置bit/ready；CP owner不被AP OFF误关；VDDDIG不低于0.95 V；generation和计数一致 |
921: | Mailbox | log、PWC、Wi-Fi与IPI并发 | 无ACK覆盖、FIFO死锁、heartbeat丢失 |
922: | 外设owner | GPIO/PWM/I2C/camera/Wi-Fi回归 | IRQ只在logical CPU0，行为与单核一致 |
923: | P0 idle | 两核空闲WFI | 可由SysTick/IPI/Mailbox唤醒，CP不进LV |
924: | P1低压 | 短/长timer deadline及RTC/GPIO唤醒循环 | deadline唤醒不丢失，时间不倒退，480 MHz/bus恢复后再运行AP |
925: | shutdown | 请求AP recovery | park/reset CPU2、释放AP PSRAM owner、关CPU2、关CPU1、最后释放频率slot |
926: 
927: 故障注入：
928: 
929: - CPU2保持reset、secondary vector错位、CPU2 IRQ route屏蔽。
930: - channel 2 FIFO full、丢kick、重复kick、pending bit竞态。
931: - CP拒绝480 MHz、强制320 MHz clamp、readback不一致。
932: - bus divider写失败、切频helper返回错误、PSRAM仍ON时请求降到60 MHz。
933: - heartbeat send返回 `-EBUSY`/`-ENOLINK`。
934: - AP在CPU2未park时请求shutdown。
935: - PSRAM OFFLINE/recovery期间CPU2发起分配。
936: - P1阶段只让一个AP核设置WFI bit，确认CP拒绝进入low-voltage。
937: - P1恢复时暂不恢复480 MHz，确认AP不解除PM barrier。
938: 
939: ## 13. 完成定义
940: 
941: 只有同时满足以下条件才算完成：
942: 
943: 1. 最终包仍只有一个AP `app1.bin`，CPU1/CPU2共享同一个NuttX实例。
944: 2. CP在CPU1 reset前建立并验证480 MHz AP档位，运行期不发生未协调DVFS。
945: 3. `CONFIG_SYSTEM_TIME64=y`，旧的长期静置重启不可复现。
946: 4. CPU2使用独立bootstrap、idle和interrupt stack，private arch状态正确。
947: 5. CPU2启动失败fail-stop，不发送虚假PWC ready。
948: 6. 双向schedule/call IPI无丢失，SMP调度和task migration稳定。
949: 7. AP_SPINLOCK atomic gate通过两核、DMA和外设并发压力。
950: 8. 只有logical CPU0产生系统tick，wall clock和heartbeat周期正确。
951: 9. CP transport和普通外设保持logical CPU0 owner且SMP-safe。
952: 10. CPU2先park/reset，CP依次关闭CPU2/CPU1，最后释放480 MHz slot并重新仲裁VDDDIG。
953: 11. S0-S4完成后通过24小时SMP稳定性测试。
954: 12. P1只有在NuttX SMP PM、AON时间、deadline wake、双核WFI barrier和恢复协议完成后
955:     才标记支持。
956: 
957: ## 14. 实施顺序总结
958: 
959: ```text
960: SYSTEM_TIME64 + CP 480 MHz单一生命周期slot
961:   -> 单核3小时验证
962:   -> SMP配置、AP_SPINLOCK和每核栈
963:   -> CPU2 secondary vector/reset/online
964:   -> channel 2 raw IPI和NuttX SMP hooks
965:   -> driver affinity与共享锁
966:   -> PSRAM/Wi-Fi/camera等功能回归
967:   -> 24小时稳定性
968:   -> AON-backed time和coordinated low-voltage
969: ```
970: 
971: 不要把低压睡眠、runtime DVFS、cacheable PSRAM、CPU2 hotplug和首次SMP启动放进同一
972: 提交。先证明固定480 MHz、64位时间、cache-off、单tick、CPU0外设owner模式下的双核
973: 调度正确，再逐项开放功耗和性能优化。

207: ## 5. OpenVela PSRAM 接入状态
208: 
209: OpenVela AP侧已经完成以下代码和离线构建基线：
210: 
211: - 精确16 MiB、RW/XN/non-cacheable MPU映射。
212: - `0x60720000..0x609fffff`独立AP PSRAM heap。
213: - USER/AUDIO/ENCODE/DISPLAY四个独立媒体pool。

257: ## 7. UART0 Mailbox V2 使用和边界
258: 
259: CP 启动后默认 owner 为 `CP_CLI`。只有 MB_UART0 STATE 成功 ACK、IPC power-up 和
260: PWC boot-ready 三个条件同时成立，且`bk_mb_uart_write_ready()`非零时，
261: `ap_console open`才允许进入。heartbeat timeout、AP reset/power-off 和 Mailbox
262: reset/timeout都会清除门禁并请求回退到CP CLI。使用方式：
263: 
264: ```text
265: ap_console status
266: ap_console open
267: <RAW AP NSH interaction>
268: <press Ctrl-], release it, then press .>
269: ap_console status
270: ```
271: 
272: `open`在当前 CP CLI 响应经 UART TX-complete 后生效，并清 CP parser 和 UART RX；
273: RAW 模式不添加前缀。退出时按下`Ctrl-]`、松开，再按`.`；该转义不依赖行首状态。
274: 链路 reset/timeout/down 时自动清理
275: 未发送输入并回到 `CP_CLI`。`status`输出 owner/link/mode、bridge ring、MB_UART 状态、
276: active channel/sequence/command 和 drop/partial/overflow/reset/timeout 统计。
277: 
278: 当前实现未声称以下项目已在实板验证：深睡 resume、AP/CP 独立重启、FIFO/stale ACK
279: 故障注入和长时间双向压力。这些仍须按移植计划测试矩阵完成。

226: static void mb_chnl_ack_retry(void)
227: {
228: 	u16 chnl_type = MB_PHY_ACK_CHNL;
229: 
230: 	while (1)
231: 	{
232: 		mb_ack_entry_t entry;
233: 		bk_err_t ret;
234: 		u32 flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
235: 
236: 		if (!ack_count || ack_sending)
237: 		{
238: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
239: 			return;
240: 		}
241: 		entry = ack_queue[ack_read];
242: 		ack_sending = 1;
243: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
244: 
245: 		ret = bk_mailbox_send_safe(&entry.data, SELF_CPU,
246: 			(mailbox_endpoint_t)entry.destination, &chnl_type);
247: 		flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
248: 		if (ret != BK_OK)
249: 		{
250: 			phy_chnl_x_cb[entry.destination].ack_retry_cnt++;
251: 			ack_sending = 0;
252: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
253: 			return;
254: 		}
255: 		ack_read = (ack_read + 1) % MB_ACK_QUEUE_LEN;
256: 		ack_count--;
257: 		ack_sending = 0;
258: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
259: 		s_mailbox_rx_ack_cnt++;
260: 		mb_chnl_notify((mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[entry.destination],
261: 			phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[entry.destination],
262: 			MB_CHNL_EVENT_RX_ACK_SENT);
263: 	}
264: }

273: 		phy_chnl_x_cb[destination].ack_queue_full_cnt++;
274: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
275: 		return false;
276: 	}
277: 	entry = &ack_queue[ack_write];
278: 	entry->data = *data;
279: 	entry->destination = destination;
280: 	ack_write = (ack_write + 1) % MB_ACK_QUEUE_LEN;
281: 	ack_count++;
282: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
283: 	mb_chnl_ack_retry();
284: 	return true;

337: 
338: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
339: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
340: 
341: #if !CONFIG_SOC_SMP
342: 	/* for SMP project, log_chnl is always built by CPU0. it is always failed when call this API in CPU1. */
343: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
344: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
345: #endif
346: 
347: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
348: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
349: 
350: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
351: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
352: 
353: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
354: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
355: 
356: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
357: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
358: 
359: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq++;
360: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl = log_chnl;
361: 
362: 	cmd_ptr = (mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *)&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff;
363: 
364: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = log_chnl;
365: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq = phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq;
366: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl  = 0;
367: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.state = 0;
368: 
369: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_hdr_cmd = cmd_ptr->hdr.cmd;
370: 
371: 	phy_chnl_ptr->param1 = cmd_ptr->param1;
372: 	phy_chnl_ptr->param2 = cmd_ptr->param2;
373: 	phy_chnl_ptr->param3 = cmd_ptr->param3;
374: 
375: 	__DMB();
376: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_CMD_CHNL;
377: 
378: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(phy_chnl_idx);
379: 
380: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_send(&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);
381: 
382: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
383: 	{
384: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt++;
385: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x40000000;
386: 
387: 		return ret_code;
388: 	}
389: 
390: 	s_mailbox_tx_cnt++;
391: 
392: 	log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
393: 
394: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr != NULL)
395: 	{
396: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param);  	/* phy_chnl is BUSY now, tx_isr will not trigger phy_chnl_start_tx. */
397: 	}
398: 
399: 	return BK_OK;
400: }

402: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr(mb_phy_chnl_ack_t *ack_ptr)
403: {
404: 	u8		log_chnl;
405: 	u8		ret_code;
406: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
407: 	u8		log_chnl_idx;
408: 
409: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
410: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
411: 
412: 	log_chnl = ack_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl;
413: 	if (ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_RESET)
414: 	{
415: 		mb_chnl_ack_t failure;
416: 
417: 		phy_chnl_idx = GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl);
418: 		if (ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl != (CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX | CHNL_CTRL_RESET) ||
419: 			ack_ptr->hdr.state != 0 || ack_ptr->hdr.cmd != 0 ||
420: 			ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq != 0 || ack_ptr->data1 != 0 ||
421: 			ack_ptr->data2 != 0 || ack_ptr->data3 != 0 ||
422: 			GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl) != SELF_CPU ||
423: 			phy_chnl_idx == SELF_CPU || phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
424: 		{
425: 			s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x10;
426: 			if (phy_chnl_idx < PHY_CHNL_NUM)
427: 				phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx].reset_bad_cnt++;
428: 			return;
429: 		}
430: 
431: 		phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
432: 		phy_chnl_ptr->recovering = 1;
433: 		log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx];
434: 		mb_chnl_notify(log_chnl_cb_x,
435: 				   phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx],
436: 				   MB_CHNL_EVENT_PEER_RESET);
437: 		u32 reset_flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
438: 		if (phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state == CHNL_STATE_BUSY)
439: 		{
440: 			phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
441: 			phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
442: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(reset_flags);
443: 			log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl);
444: 			if (log_chnl_idx < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx] &&
445: 				log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr)
446: 			{
447: 				memset(&failure, 0, sizeof(failure));
448: 				failure.hdr.cmd = phy_chnl_ptr->tx_hdr_cmd;
449: 				failure.hdr.state = CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;
450: 				log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr(
451: 					log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, &failure);
452: 			}
453: 			bk_mailbox_tx_timeout((mailbox_endpoint_t)phy_chnl_idx);
454: 		}
455: 		else
456: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(reset_flags);
457: 		mb_chnl_fail_pending(log_chnl_cb_x,
458: 				     phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]);
459: 		return;
460: 	}
461: 
462: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
463: 	log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
464: 
465: 	s_mailbox_tx_ack_cnt++;
466: 
467: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl)) {
468: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x1;
469: 		return;
470: 	}
471: 
472: 
473: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // received from self.
474: 	{
475: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x2;
476: 		return;
477: 	}
478: 
479: 
480: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM){
481: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x4;
482: 		return;
483: 	}
484: 
485: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
486: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
487: 
488: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
489: 	{
490: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x8;
491: 		return;
492: 	}
493: 
494: 	u32 claim_flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
495: 	if (phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state != CHNL_STATE_BUSY ||
496: 		(ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl != CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX) ||
497: 		 (ack_ptr->hdr.state & ~CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL) ||
498: 		 (log_chnl != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl) ||
499: 		 (ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq) ||
500: 		 (ack_ptr->hdr.cmd != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_hdr_cmd))
501: 	{
502: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt++;
503: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt |= 0x40000000;
504: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(claim_flags);
505: 		return;
506: 	}
507: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
508: 	phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
509: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(claim_flags);
510: 
511: 	bk_mailbox_tx_complete((mailbox_endpoint_t)phy_chnl_idx);
512: 
513: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr != NULL)
514: 	{
515: 		/* clear following header members. */
516: 		ack_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
517: 		ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
518: 		ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
519: 
520: 		/* hdr.state, hdr.cmd these 2 members keep untouched. */
521: 		s_mailbox_tx_compl_cnt++;
522: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, (mb_chnl_ack_t *)ack_ptr);
523: 	} else {
524: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x100;
525: 	}
526: 
527: 	u32 int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
528: 	if (phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state != CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
529: 	{
530: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
531: 		return;
532: 	}
533: 	for(log_chnl_idx = 0; log_chnl_idx < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]; log_chnl_idx++)  /* priority descended search. */
534: 	{
535: 		if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state != CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
536: 			break;
537: 	}
538: 
539: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
540: 	{
541: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
542: 		return;
543: 	}
544: 
545: 	log_chnl = CPX_LOG_CHNL_START(SELF_CPU, phy_chnl_idx) + log_chnl_idx;
546: 
547: 	/* About to dispatch the next pending tx on this physical channel:
548: 	 * refresh the busy-watchdog timestamp so its lifetime starts from
549: 	 * here rather than carrying over from the previous transaction. */
550: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_BUSY;
551: 	phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = rtos_get_time();
552: 
553: 	ret_code = mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(log_chnl);
554: 
555: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
556: 	{
557: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
558: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state               = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
559: 		phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms          = 0;
560: 	}
561: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
562: 
563: 	return;
564: 
565: }

567: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_cmd_isr(mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_ptr)
568: {
569: 	phy_chnnl_hdr_t  chnl_hdr;
570: 	u8			log_chnl = cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl;
571: 
572: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
573: 	u8		log_chnl_idx;
574: 
575: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
576: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
577: 
578: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = SRC_CPU_ID; from SRC_CPU.
579: 	log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
580: 
581: 	s_mailbox_rx_cnt++;
582: 
583: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
584: 		return;
585: 
586: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // received from self.
587: 		return;
588: 
589: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
590: 		return;
591: 
592: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
593: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
594: 
595: 	chnl_hdr.data = cmd_ptr->hdr.data;
596: 
597: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
598: 	{
599: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt++;
600: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt |= 0x80000000;
601: 
602: 		return;
603: 	}
604: 
605: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_status_isr != NULL)
606: 	{
607: 		/* clear all other hdr members except hdr.cmd. */
608: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
609: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
610: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
611: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.state        = 0;
612: 
613: 		if (log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_status_isr(
614: 			log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param,
615: 			(mb_chnl_cmd_t *)cmd_ptr) != BK_OK)
616: 			chnl_hdr.state |= CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;
617: 	}
618: 	else if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr != NULL)
619: 	{
620: 		/* clear all other hdr members except hdr.cmd. */
621: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
622: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
623: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
624: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.state        = 0;
625: 
626: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, (mb_chnl_cmd_t *)cmd_ptr);
627: 
628: 		/* !!!! cmd_ptr buffer now contains ACK data !!!!. */
629: 	}
630: 	else
631: 	{
632: 		memset(cmd_ptr, 0, sizeof(*cmd_ptr));
633: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.data = chnl_hdr.data;
634: 		chnl_hdr.state |= CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;		/* cmd NO target app, it is an ACK bit to peer CPU. */
635: 	}
636: 
637: 	if(chnl_hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX)
638: 	{
639: 		/* sync tx cmd, do NOT send ACK. */
640: 		return;
641: 	}
642: 
643: 	/* RE-USE the copied command buffer to construct the stable ACK. */
644: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.data  = chnl_hdr.data;
645: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl |= CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX;			/* ACK msg, use the ACK channel.  */
646: 
647: 	if (!mb_chnl_ack_enqueue(phy_chnl_idx, (mailbox_data_t *)cmd_ptr))
648: 	{
649: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt++;
650: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x80000000;
651: 		return;
652: 	}
653: 	return;
654: }

656: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_isr(mailbox_data_t * mb_data)
657: {
658: 	mb_phy_chnl_union_t	rx_data;
659: 
660: 	rx_data.mb_data.param0 = mb_data->param0;
661: 	rx_data.mb_data.param1 = mb_data->param1;
662: 	rx_data.mb_data.param2 = mb_data->param2;
663: 	rx_data.mb_data.param3 = mb_data->param3;
664: 	/* the following process will damage the input parameter,
665: 	so pass in the pointer of copied parameter instad of the original. */
666: 
667: 	/*
668: 	 *  there are 2 boxes in one MAILBOXn HW,
669: 	 *  but no way to know which box this msg is from in current mailbox_driver design.
670: 	 *  so use the CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX bit in the msg hdr.ctrl to distinguish where it is from.
671: 	 *  when CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX is set, it means from ack box ( MAILBOXn_BOX1 ).
672: 	 */
673: 	if(rx_data.phy_ch_hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX)		/* rx ack. */
674: 	{
675: 		mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr(&rx_data.phy_ch_ack);
676: 	}
677: 	else		/* rx cmd. */
678: 	{
679: 		mb_phy_chnl_rx_cmd_isr(&rx_data.phy_ch_cmd);
680: 	}
681: }

683: static bk_err_t mb_phy_chnl_start_tx(u8 log_chnl)
684: {
685: 	bk_err_t	ret_code;
686: 
687: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
688: 
689: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
690: 
691: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
692: 
693: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
694: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
695: 
696: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
697: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
698: 
699: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
700: 
701: 	if(phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state == CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
702: 	{
703: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_BUSY;		/* MUST set channel state to BUSY firstly. */
704: 		phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = rtos_get_time();
705: 		/* start_tx->tx_cmd->tx_isr callback->mb_chnl_write->start_tx, it is a loop.
706: 		   break the loop by setting the phy_chnl_cb.tx_state to busy. */
707: 
708: 		ret_code = mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(log_chnl);
709: 
710: 		if(ret_code != BK_OK)
711: 		{
712: 			/* tx_cmd failed before the data hit hardware: roll back BOTH
713: 			 * physical and logical state, so the caller can retry and so
714: 			 * the logical channel does not stay BUSY forever. */
715: 			u8                   log_chnl_idx_fail = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
716: 			mb_log_chnl_cb_t    *log_chnl_cb_x_fail =
717: 				(mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
718: 
719: 			if (log_chnl_idx_fail < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]) {
720: 				log_chnl_cb_x_fail[log_chnl_idx_fail].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
721: 			}
722: 			phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
723: 			phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
724: 			return ret_code;
725: 		}
726: 	}
727: 
728: 	return BK_OK;
729: }

731: volatile uint32_t s_mailbox_sync_cnt = 0;
732: 
733: static bk_err_t mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd_sync(u8 log_chnl, mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_ptr)
734: {
735: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
736: 	u16 			chnl_type;
737: 
738: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
739: 
740: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
741: 
742: #if !CONFIG_SOC_SMP
743: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
744: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
745: #endif
746: 
747: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
748: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
749: 
750: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
751: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
752: 
753: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(phy_chnl_idx);
754: 
755: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = log_chnl;
756: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq = 0;
757: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl  = CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX;
758: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.state = 0;
759: 
760: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_CMD_CHNL;
761: 
762: 	s_mailbox_sync_cnt++;
763: 
764: 	/*
765: 	 * can't wait 'phy_chnl_cb.tx_state' to be CHNL_STATE_IDLE here,
766: 	 * 'phy_chnl_cb.tx_state' is set to CHNL_STATE_IDLE in interrupt callback.
767: 	 * but the interrupt may be disabled when this API is called.
768: 	 *    wait physical channel HW to be IDLE by <POLLing> !!
769: 	 */
770: 	while(1)
771: 	{
772: 		ret_code = bk_mailbox_send_safe((mailbox_data_t *)cmd_ptr, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);
773: 
774: 		if(ret_code != BK_ERR_MAILBOX_TIMEOUT)
775: 		{
776: 			break;
777: 		}
778: 	}
779: 
780: 	return ret_code;
781: }

784: /* =====================      logical channel APIs      ==================*/
785: /*
786:   * init logical chnanel module.
787:   * return:
788:   *     succeed: BK_OK;
789:   *     failed  : fail code.
790:   *
791:   */
792: bk_err_t mb_chnl_init(void)
793: {
794: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
795: 	int				i, j;
796: 
797: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
798: 
799: 	/*
800: 	 * mb_chnl_init() is reached from mb_chnl_open(), which is called by
801: 	 * many subsystems (shell log forwarding, ipc_init, mb_uart, ...).
802: 	 * Each one of those callers runs on its own FreeRTOS task and they
803: 	 * can race here:
804: 	 *
805: 	 *   Task A: enters mb_chnl_open(MB_CHNL_LOG), sees mb_chnnl_init_ok==0,
806: 	 *           enters mb_chnl_init(), runs all the memset's, sets
807: 	 *           mb_chnnl_init_ok=1, returns. Caller then sets
808: 	 *           log_chnl_cb2[15].in_used=1 and installs rx_isr.
809: 	 *   Task B (preempted in the middle of mb_chnl_open before the
810: 	 *           init_ok check finishes): comes back, sees init_ok still
811: 	 *           == 0 (because it sampled before A set it), enters
812: 	 *           mb_chnl_init() AGAIN, and the memset wipes the
813: 	 *           log_chnl_cb_x[] array that A just populated.
814: 	 *
815: 	 * Fix: serialize the body with the existing critical section so the
816: 	 * "if (init_ok) return; ... init_ok = 1;" sequence is atomic w.r.t.
817: 	 * other tasks. The double-check pattern still keeps the fast path
818: 	 * lock-free once init has completed.
819: 	 */
820: 	if(mb_chnnl_init_ok)
821: 	{
822: 		return BK_OK;
823: 	}
824: 
825: 	uint32_t init_int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
826: 	if(mb_chnnl_init_ok)
827: 	{
828: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(init_int_mask);
829: 		return BK_OK;
830: 	}
831: 
832: 	memset(&phy_chnl_x_cb, 0, sizeof(phy_chnl_x_cb));
833: 	memset(ack_queue, 0, sizeof(ack_queue));
834: 	ack_read = 0;
835: 	ack_write = 0;
836: 	ack_count = 0;
837: 	ack_sending = 0;
838: 	for(i = 0; i < PHY_CHNL_NUM; i++)
839: 	{
840: 		phy_chnl_x_cb[i].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
841: 
842: 		log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[i]);
843: 
844: 		memset(log_chnl_cb_x, 0, sizeof(mb_log_chnl_cb_t) * phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[i]);
845: 
846: 		for(j = 0; j < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[i]; j++)
847: 		{
848: 			log_chnl_cb_x[j].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
849: 		}
850: 	}
851: 
852: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_init();
853: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
854: 	{
855: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(init_int_mask);
856: 		return ret_code;
857: 	}
858: 
859: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu;
860: 
861: 	for(i = 0; i < PHY_CHNL_NUM; i++)
862: 	{
863: 		dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(i);  // dst_cpu_id;
864: 
865: 		bk_mailbox_recv_callback_register(dst_cpu, SELF_CPU, mb_phy_chnl_rx_isr);
866: 	}
867: 
868: 	mb_chnnl_init_ok = 1;
869: 	bk_mailbox_rx_ready_callback_register(mb_chnl_rx_ready);
870: 
871: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(init_int_mask);
872: 
873: 	return BK_OK;
874: }

989:   * write to logical chnanel.
990:   * input:
991:   *     log_chnl     : logical channel id to write.
992:   *     cmd_buf     : buffer of channel cmd data.
993:   * return:
994:   *     succeed: BK_OK;
995:   *     failed  : fail code.
996:   *
997:   */
998: bk_err_t mb_chnl_write(u8 log_chnl, mb_chnl_cmd_t * cmd_buf)
999: {
1000: 	u16		write_len;
1001: 
1002: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
1003: 	u8		log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
1004: 
1005: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
1006: 
1007: #if !CONFIG_SOC_SMP
1008: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
1009: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
1010: #endif
1011: 
1012: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
1013: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
1014: 
1015: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
1016: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
1017: 
1018: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
1019: 
1020: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
1021: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
1022: 
1023: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].in_used == 0)
1024: 		return BK_ERR_STATE;
1025: 
1026: 	u32 int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
1027: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t *phy = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
1028: 	mb_chnl_cmd_t *logical_cmd = cmd_buf;
1029: 
1030: 	if (phy->recovering &&
1031: 		!(log_chnl == MB_CHNL_UART0 &&
1032: 		  logical_cmd->hdr.cmd == MB_UART_STATE_COMMAND))
1033: 	{
1034: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
1035: 		return BK_ERR_BUSY;
1036: 	}
1037: 
1038: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state != CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
1039: 	{
1040: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
1041: 
1042: 		return BK_ERR_BUSY;
1043: 	}
1044: 
1045: 	write_len = sizeof(mailbox_data_t) > sizeof(mb_chnl_cmd_t) ? sizeof(mb_chnl_cmd_t) : sizeof(mailbox_data_t);
1046: 
1047: 	memset(&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff, 0,
1048: 	       sizeof(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff));
1049: 	memcpy(&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff, cmd_buf, write_len);
1050: 
1051: 	/* set to BUSY means there is data in tx-buff. mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr will get it to send. */
1052: 	log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_BUSY;   /* MUST set to BUSY after data was copied. */
1053: 	__DMB();
1054: 
1055: 	bk_err_t start_ret = mb_phy_chnl_start_tx(log_chnl);
1056: 
1057: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
1058: 
1059: 	return start_ret;
1060: }

1063:   * logical chnanel misc io (set/get param).
1064:   * input:

1067:   *     param      :  parameter of the command.

1070:   *     failed  : fail code.
1071:   *
1072:   */
1073: bk_err_t mb_chnl_ctrl(u8 log_chnl, u8 cmd, void * param)
1074: {
1075: 	bk_err_t	ret_code;
1076: 
1077: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
1078: 	u8		log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
1079: 
1080: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
1081: 
1082: #if !CONFIG_SOC_SMP
1083: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
1084: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
1085: #endif
1086: 
1087: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
1088: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
1089: 
1090: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
1091: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
1092: 
1093: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
1094: 
1095: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
1096: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
1097: 
1098: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].in_used == 0)
1099: 		return BK_ERR_STATE;
1100: 
1101: 	switch(cmd)
1102: 	{
1103: 		case MB_CHNL_GET_STATUS:
1104: 
1105: 			if(param == NULL)
1106: 				return BK_ERR_NULL_PARAM;
1107: 
1108: 			*((u8 *)param) = log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state;
1109: 
1110: 			break;
1111: 
1112: 		case MB_CHNL_SET_RX_ISR:
1113: 			log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr = (chnl_rx_isr_t)param;
1114: 			break;
1115: 		case MB_CHNL_SET_RX_STATUS_ISR:
1116: 			log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_status_isr =
1117: 				(chnl_rx_status_isr_t)param;
1118: 			break;
1119: 
1120: 		case MB_CHNL_SET_TX_ISR:
1121: 			log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr = (chnl_tx_isr_t)param;
1122: 			break;
1123: 
1124: 		case MB_CHNL_SET_TX_CMPL_ISR:
1125: 			log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr = (chnl_tx_cmpl_isr_t)param;
1126: 			break;
1127: 		case MB_CHNL_SET_EVENT_ISR:
1128: 			log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].event_isr = (chnl_event_isr_t)param;
1129: 			break;
1130: 
1131: 		case MB_CHNL_WRITE_SYNC:
1132: 			if(param == NULL)
1133: 				return BK_ERR_NULL_PARAM;
1134: 
1135: 			ret_code = mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd_sync(log_chnl, (mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *)param);
1136: 			return ret_code;
1137: 			break;
1138: 
1139: 		default:
1140: 			return BK_ERR_NOT_SUPPORT;
1141: 			break;
1142: 	}
1143: 
1144: 	return BK_OK;

1147: void mb_chnl_poll(void)
1148: {
1149: 	u8 phy_idx;
1150: 
1151: 	bk_mailbox_poll();
1152: 	mb_chnl_ack_retry();
1153: 
1154: 	for (phy_idx = 0; phy_idx < PHY_CHNL_NUM; phy_idx++)
1155: 	{
1156: 		mb_phy_chnl_cb_t *phy = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_idx];
1157: 		mb_log_chnl_cb_t *logs;
1158: 		mb_chnl_ack_t failure;
1159: 		u8 log_idx;
1160: 
1161: 		u32 claim_flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
1162: 		if ((phy->tx_state != CHNL_STATE_BUSY) || !phy->busy_since_ms ||
1163: 			((u32)(rtos_get_time() - phy->busy_since_ms) < MB_PHY_CHNL_BUSY_TIMEOUT_MS))
1164: 		{
1165: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(claim_flags);
1166: 			continue;
1167: 		}
1168: 		phy->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
1169: 		phy->busy_since_ms = 0;
1170: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(claim_flags);
1171: 
1172: 		logs = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_idx];
1173: 		log_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(phy->tx_log_chnl);
1174: 		if (log_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_idx])
1175: 			continue;
1176: 
1177: 		phy->tx_fault_cnt++;
1178: 		phy->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x20000000;
1179: 		bk_mailbox_tx_timeout((mailbox_endpoint_t)phy_idx);
1180: 		phy->recovering = 1;
1181: 		memset(&failure, 0, sizeof(failure));
1182: 		failure.hdr.cmd = phy->tx_hdr_cmd;
1183: 		failure.hdr.state = CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;
1184: 		if (logs[log_idx].tx_cmpl_isr)
1185: 			logs[log_idx].tx_cmpl_isr(logs[log_idx].isr_param, &failure);
1186: 		mb_chnl_fail_pending(logs, phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_idx]);
1187: 		mb_chnl_notify(logs, phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_idx],
1188: 				   MB_CHNL_EVENT_TX_TIMEOUT);
1189: 		if (mb_phy_chnl_send_reset(phy_idx, phy->tx_log_chnl) == BK_OK)
1190: 			mb_chnl_notify(logs, phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_idx],
1191: 					   MB_CHNL_EVENT_ABORT_SENT);
1192: 		else
1193: 			mb_chnl_notify(logs, phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_idx],
1194: 					   MB_CHNL_EVENT_ABORT_FAILED);
1195: 	}
1196: }

113: static int ipc_heartbeat_timeout(void)
114: {
115: 	u32   cur_time;
116: 
117: 	cur_time = (u32)rtos_get_time();
118: 
119: 	if(cpu_x_state == CORE_POWER_OFF)
120: 	{
121: 		return 0;
122: 	}
123: 	if((cpu_x_state == CORE_STARTING) || (cpu_x_dump != 0))
124: 	{
125: 		cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp = cur_time;
126: 		return 0;
127: 	}
128: 
129: 	if(cur_time >= cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp)
130: 	{
131: 		cur_time -= cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp;
132: 	}
133: 	else
134: 	{
135: 		cur_time += (~(cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp)) + 1;  // wrap around.
136: 	}
137: 
138: 	if(cur_time < HB_TIMEOUT_MS)
139: 	{
140: 		cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp = (u32)rtos_get_time();
141: 		return 0;
142: 	}
143: 
144: 	if (bk_pm_module_lv_sleep_state_get(PM_DEV_ID_DEFAULT))
145: 	{
146: 		cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp = (u32)rtos_get_time();
147: 		bk_pm_module_lv_sleep_state_clear(PM_DEV_ID_DEFAULT);
148: 		return 0;
149: 	}
150: 
151: 	if(s_mb_ipc_work_state == MB_IPC_EXIT_LV)
152: 	{
153: 		cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp = (u32)rtos_get_time();
154: 		s_mb_ipc_work_state = MB_IPC_WORKING;
155: 		return 0;
156: 	}
157: 
158: 	return 1;
159: }

219: static void mb_ipc_task( void *para )
220: {
221: 	bk_err_t	ret_val;
222: 	u32    events;
223: 	u32    check_time = BEKEN_WAIT_FOREVER;
224: 
225: 	mb_ipc_init_lv_callback();
226: 
227: 	ret_val = rtos_init_event_ex(&mb_ipc_heart_event);
228: 
229: 	if(ret_val != BK_OK)
230: 	{
231: 		rtos_delete_thread(NULL);
232: 		return;
233: 	}
234: 
235: 	while(1)
236: 	{
237: 		events = rtos_wait_event_ex(&mb_ipc_heart_event, MB_IPC_ALL_FLAGS, true, check_time);
238: 
239: 		if(events == 0)
240: 		{
241: 			// timeout, so check heartbeat.
242: 			events = MB_IPC_HEARTBEAT_FLAG;
243: 		}
244: 
245: 		if(events & MB_IPC_STOP_CORE_FLAG)  // process this event at first!!!!
246: 		{
247: 			if(cpu_x_state == CORE_POWER_OFF)
248: 			{
249: 				events = 0;  // clear all events.
250: 			}
251: 		}
252: 
253: 		if(events & MB_IPC_START_CORE_FLAG)
254: 		{
255: 			u8   retry_cnt = 0;
256: 
257: 			while(cpu_x_state == CORE_STARTING)
258: 			{
259: 				ipc_heartbeat_timeout();
260: 
261: 				if(events & MB_IPC_POWER_UP_FLAG)

263: 					if(cpu_x_state == CORE_STARTING)
264: 					{

267: 					}
268: 				}
269: 				else
270: 				{
271: 					if( retry_cnt > 3)
272: 					{
273: 						BK_DUMP_OUT("IPC retry to start core%d, retry_cnt:%d\r\n", cpu_x_id, retry_cnt);

279: 						events = rtos_wait_event_ex(&mb_ipc_heart_event, MB_IPC_POWER_UP_FLAG, true, 2000);//2s
280: 					}
281: 				}
282: 
283: 				retry_cnt++;
284: 			}
285: 
286: 			// discard this event when not in CORE_STARTING state.
287: 		}
288: 
289: 		if(events & MB_IPC_HEARTBEAT_FLAG)
290: 		{
291: 			if(ipc_heartbeat_timeout())
292: 			{

298: 			}
299: 		}

304: 		}

136: {

144:     if (s_pm_info->queue)
145:     {

147: 
148:         if (BK_OK != ret)
149:         {
150:             LOGE("%s failed\n", __func__);
151:             return BK_FAIL;

154:         return ret;

159: static bk_err_t low_pwr_core_message_handle(void)
160: {
161:     bk_err_t ret = BK_OK;
162:     low_pwr_core_msg_t msg;
163: 
164:     while (1)
165:     {
166:         ret = rtos_pop_from_queue(&s_pm_info->queue, &msg, BEKEN_WAIT_FOREVER);
167: 		LOGV("LP event:%d\n", msg.event);
168:         if (kNoErr == ret)
169:         {
170:             switch (msg.event)
171:             {
172:                 case LOW_PWR_CORE_STATE_ENTER_DEEPSLEEP:
173:                 {
174: 					bk_pm_cp0_response_cp1(PM_ENTER_DEEP_SLEEP_CMD,BK_OK,0,0);

176:                 }
177:                 break;
178: 				case LOW_PWR_CORE_CTRL_CP2_STATE:
179: 				{
180: 					bk_pm_cp0_response_cp1(PM_CTRL_AP_STATE_CMD, BK_OK,0,0);
181: 					bk_pm_module_vote_boot_cp1_ctrl(msg.param1,msg.param2);
182: 				}
183: 				break;
184: 				case LOW_PWR_CORE_CP2_RECOVERY:
185: 				{
186: 					bk_pm_cp1_recovery_module_state_ctrl(msg.param1,msg.param2);
187: 				}
188: 				break;
189: 				case LOW_PWR_CORE_RTC_DEEPSLEEP:
190: 				{
191: 					bk_pm_cp0_response_cp1(PM_RTC_DEEPSLEEP_CMD, BK_OK,0,0);

194: 				break;

196: 				{
197: 					uint32_t cp_pm_data = 0;
198: 					pm_ap_get_cp_data_type_e data_type = msg.param1;
199: 					switch(data_type)
200: 					{
201: 						case PM_CP_DATE_TYPE_TIME_INTERVAL_FROM_STARTUP:
202: 							bk_low_pwr_misc_get_time_interval_from_startup(&cp_pm_data);
203: 						break;
204: 						case PM_CP_DATE_TYPE_DEEP_SLEEP_WAKEUP_SOURCE:
205: 							cp_pm_data = bk_pm_deep_sleep_wakeup_source_get();

94:     }

96:   message.param1 = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[1];
97:   message.param2 = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[2];
98:   message.param3 = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[3];
99:   g_queue[g_head] = message;
100:   g_head = next;
101:   nxsem_post(&g_pwc_sem);

431: {
432: 	uint32_t clk_param  = 0;
433: 	uint32_t     h_vol  = 0;
434: 	if(cksel_core > 3)
435: 	{
436: 		BK_LOGD(NULL,"set dvfs cksel core > 3 invalid %d\r\n",cksel_core);

440: 	if((ckdiv_core > PM_FREQUNCY_DIV_MAX) || (ckdiv_bus > PM_FREQUNCY_DIV_BUS_MAX)||(ckdiv_cpu1 > PM_FREQUNCY_DIV_CPU_MAX)||(ckdiv_cpu0 > PM_FREQUNCY_DIV_CPU_MAX))
441: 	{
442: 		BK_LOGD(NULL,"set dvfs ckdiv_core ckdiv_bus ckdiv_cpu0_1  ckdiv_cpu0_1  > 1 invalid\r\n");
443: 		return BK_FAIL;
444: 	}
445: 	if((cksel_core == PM_CLKSEL_CORE_320M)&&(ckdiv_core == PM_CLKDIV_CORE_0)&&(ckdiv_cpu0 != PM_CLKDV_CPU0_0))
446: 	{
447: 		BK_LOGD(NULL,"unsupport the cpu freq setting %d %d %d\r\n",cksel_core,ckdiv_core,ckdiv_cpu0);
448: 		return BK_FAIL;
449: 	}
450: 
451: 	if((cksel_core == PM_CLKSEL_CORE_320M)&&(ckdiv_core == PM_CLKDIV_CORE_0))
452: 	{
453: 		h_vol = sys_hal_vdddig_h_vol_get();
454: 		if(h_vol < PM_VDDDIG_H_VOL_0v9)
455: 		{
456: 			sys_hal_ctrl_vddd_h_vol(PM_VDDD_H_VOL_1V);
457: 			sys_hal_ctrl_vdddig_h_vol(PM_VDDDIG_H_VOL_0v9);
458: 		}
459: 	}
460: 	clk_param = 0;
461: 	clk_param = sys_hal_all_modules_clk_div_get(CLK_DIV_REG0);
462: 	if(((clk_param >> 0x4)&0x3) > cksel_core)//when it from the higher frequency to lower frequency
463: 	{
464: 		/*1.core clk select*/
465: 		clk_param = 0;
466: 		clk_param = sys_hal_all_modules_clk_div_get(CLK_DIV_REG0);
467: 		clk_param &=  ~(0x3 << 4);
468: 		clk_param |=  cksel_core << 4;
469: 		sys_hal_all_modules_clk_div_set(CLK_DIV_REG0,clk_param);
470: 
471: 		/*2.config bus and core clk div*/
472: 		clk_param = 0;
473: 		clk_param = sys_hal_all_modules_clk_div_get(CLK_DIV_REG0);
474: 		clk_param &= ~((0xF << 0) | (0x1 << 6));
475: 		clk_param |= (ckdiv_core << 0) | (ckdiv_bus << 6);
476: 		sys_hal_all_modules_clk_div_set(CLK_DIV_REG0,clk_param);
477: 
478: 		/*3.config cpu clk div*/
479: 		sys_hal_cpu_clk_div_set(0,ckdiv_cpu0);
480: 		sys_hal_cpu_clk_div_set(1,ckdiv_cpu1);
481: 		sys_hal_cpu_clk_div_set(2,1);//config cpu2
482: 	}
483: 	else//when it from the lower frequency to higher frequency
484: 	{
485: 		/*1.config bus and core clk div*/
486: 		if(ckdiv_core == 0)
487: 		{
488: 			sys_hal_cpu_clk_div_set(0,ckdiv_cpu0);//avoid the bus freq > 240m
489: 		}
490: 
491: 		clk_param = 0;
492: 		clk_param = sys_hal_all_modules_clk_div_get(CLK_DIV_REG0);
493: 		clk_param &= ~((0xF << 0) | (0x1 << 6));
494: 		clk_param |= (ckdiv_core << 0) | (ckdiv_bus << 6);
495: 		sys_hal_all_modules_clk_div_set(CLK_DIV_REG0,clk_param);
496: 
497: 		/*2.config cpu clk div*/
498: 		if(ckdiv_core != 0)
499: 		{
500: 			sys_hal_cpu_clk_div_set(0,ckdiv_cpu0);
501: 		}
502: 		sys_hal_cpu_clk_div_set(1,ckdiv_cpu1);
503: 		sys_hal_cpu_clk_div_set(2,1);//config cpu2
504: 
505: 		/*3.core clk select*/
506: 
507: 		clk_param = 0;
508: 		clk_param = sys_hal_all_modules_clk_div_get(CLK_DIV_REG0);
509: 		clk_param &=  ~(0x3 << 4);
510: 		clk_param |=  cksel_core << 4;
511: 		sys_hal_all_modules_clk_div_set(CLK_DIV_REG0,clk_param);
512: 	}
513: 
514: 	clk_param = sys_hal_all_modules_clk_div_get(CLK_DIV_REG0);
515: 	if (((clk_param >> 4) & 0x3) != cksel_core ||
516: 		((clk_param >> 0) & 0xF) != ckdiv_core ||
517: 		((clk_param >> 6) & 0x1) != ckdiv_bus ||
518: 		sys_hal_cpu_clk_div_get(0) != ckdiv_cpu0 ||
519: 		sys_hal_cpu_clk_div_get(1) != ckdiv_cpu1 ||
520: 		sys_hal_cpu_clk_div_get(2) != 1)
521: 	{
522: 		BK_LOGE(NULL, "dvfs readback mismatch clk=0x%x cpu=%d/%d/%d\r\n",
523: 			clk_param, sys_hal_cpu_clk_div_get(0),
524: 			sys_hal_cpu_clk_div_get(1), sys_hal_cpu_clk_div_get(2));
525: 		return BK_FAIL;
526: 	}
527: 
528: 	return BK_OK;
529: }

897: static bk_err_t pm_psram_power_ctrl(pm_power_psram_module_name_e module,pm_power_module_state_e power_state)
898: {
899: 	bk_err_t ret = BK_OK;
900: #if CONFIG_PSRAM
901: 	GLOBAL_INT_DECLARATION();
902: 	uint32_t owner_bit;
903: 
904: 	if (module >= PM_POWER_PSRAM_MODULE_NAME_MAX)
905: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
906: 	owner_bit = 0x1U << module;
907: 
908:     if(power_state == PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_ON)//power on
909:     {
910: 		if (s_pm_psram_ctrl_state & owner_bit)
911: 			return BK_OK;
912: 		if(s_pm_psram_ctrl_state == 0)
913: 		{
914: 			ret = bk_pm_module_vote_vdddig_ctrl(PM_VDDDIG_MODULE_PSRAM,
915: 				PM_VDDDIG_HIGH_STATE_ON);
916: 			if (ret != BK_OK)
917: 				return ret;
918: 		}
919: 		ret = bk_psram_init();
920: 		if(ret != BK_OK)
921: 		{
922: 			LOGE("psram init owner=%d ret=%d\r\n", module, ret);
923: 			if (s_pm_psram_ctrl_state == 0)
924: 				bk_pm_module_vote_vdddig_ctrl(PM_VDDDIG_MODULE_PSRAM,
925: 					PM_VDDDIG_HIGH_STATE_OFF);
926: 			return ret;
927: 		}
928: 		GLOBAL_INT_DISABLE();
929: 		s_pm_psram_ctrl_state |= owner_bit;
930:         GLOBAL_INT_RESTORE();
931: 	}
932:     else //power down
933:     {
934: 		if(s_pm_psram_ctrl_state & owner_bit)
935: 		{
936: 			GLOBAL_INT_DISABLE();
937: 			s_pm_psram_ctrl_state &= ~owner_bit;
938: 			GLOBAL_INT_RESTORE();
939: 			#if !CONFIG_PM_PSRAM_FORCE_ON
940: 			if(0x0 == s_pm_psram_ctrl_state)
941: 			{
942: 				ret = bk_psram_deinit();
943: 				if (ret != BK_OK)
944: 				{
945: 					GLOBAL_INT_DISABLE();
946: 					s_pm_psram_ctrl_state |= owner_bit;
947: 					GLOBAL_INT_RESTORE();
948: 					return ret;
949: 				}
950: 				bk_pm_module_vote_vdddig_ctrl(PM_VDDDIG_MODULE_PSRAM,PM_VDDDIG_HIGH_STATE_OFF);
951: 				FIXED_ADDR_PSRAM_POWER_DOWN = PM_PSRAM_POWER_DOWN_MAGIC;
952:                 bk_pm_get_cp1_psram_malloc_count(0x1);
953: 			}
954: 			#endif
955: 		}
956: 	}
957: #endif
958: 	return ret;
959: }

1: # Beken AVDK 覆盖与构建基线
2: 
3: 本目录保存 BK7258 OpenVela 最终固件构建所需的 Beken AVDK 覆盖文件，并作为
4: 多人协作时 `bk_avdk_smp` 修改的同步记录。不要只修改工作区中的
5: `~/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp`；可复现修改必须同时更新本目录及本文档。
6: 
7: ## 1. 当前覆盖文件
8: 
9: | 比赛仓权威副本 | `bk_avdk_smp` 目标文件 | 作用 |
10: | --- | --- | --- |
11: | `cp/components/bk_cli/cli_main.c` | `cp/components/bk_cli/cli_main.c` | 注册 `ap_console` CLI 命令 |
12: | `cp/components/bk_cli/shell_task.c` | `cp/components/bk_cli/shell_task.c` | UART0 CP_CLI/AP_CONSOLE owner 状态机、延迟切换和退出转义 |
13: | `cp/components/bk_pm/pm.c` | `cp/components/bk_pm/pm.c` | DVFS 错误传播、vote/cache rollback 和 CPU/PSRAM 联合 VDDDIG 下限 |
14: | `cp/components/bk_startup/system_main.c` | `cp/components/bk_startup/system_main.c` | CPU1/CPU2 语义化 reset helper、run-status readback |
15: | `cp/components/controller_if/cif_ipc.c` | `cp/components/controller_if/cif_ipc.c` | 保留 Wi-Fi IPC RX status callback ABI |
16: | `cp/include/components/ap_console_bridge.h` | `cp/include/components/ap_console_bridge.h` | CP UART0 bridge 模式、写入和统计接口 |
17: | `cp/include/components/shell_task.h` | `cp/include/components/shell_task.h` | shell 与 bridge 的切换/链路事件接口 |
18: | `cp/include/components/system.h` | `cp/include/components/system.h` | CPU reset/readback 语义化接口 |
19: | `cp/include/driver/mailbox_channel.h` | `cp/include/driver/mailbox_channel.h` | transport event、诊断和 poll 接口 |
20: | `cp/include/driver/mb_uart_driver.h` | `cp/include/driver/mb_uart_driver.h` | MB_UART link event、状态和 poll 接口 |
21: | `cp/include/driver/pwr_clk.h` | `cp/include/driver/pwr_clk.h` | PSRAM V1、OpenVela lifecycle 与 PM 诊断接口 |
22: | `cp/middleware/driver/common/driver.c` | `cp/middleware/driver/common/driver.c` | MB_UART0 唯一 owner、LOG/RAW RX、1024 B TX ring 和 worker |
23: | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mailbox_channel.c` | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mailbox_channel.c` | 完整 ACK 匹配、timeout/reset、probe 和诊断 |
24: | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_ipc_cmd.c` | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_ipc_cmd.c` | IPC power-up ready 门禁事件 |
25: | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_ipc_heartbeat.c` | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_ipc_heartbeat.c` | heartbeat/reset/down 自动回退事件 |
26: | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_uart_driver.c` | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_uart_driver.c` | 严格 DATA/STATE 校验、ACK 后推进和 link event |
27: | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_adapter.c` | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_adapter.c` | command/ACK/reset/sync 分离稳定 slot |
28: | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_adapter.h` | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_adapter.h` | 稳定 slot 完成和 quarantine 接口 |
29: | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_drv.c` | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_drv.c` | RX 资源门禁、FIFO poll 和 destination count |
30: | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_drv.h` | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_drv.h` | MBOX0 poll、ready callback 和 FIFO count API |
31: | `cp/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/Kconfig` | `cp/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/Kconfig` | 默认关闭的 `CONFIG_OPENVELA_AP_480M` 开关 |
32: | `cp/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/low_pwr_core.c` | `cp/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/low_pwr_core.c` | PSRAM V1 真实 ret/version 与 PM readback response |
33: | `cp/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/pwr_clk.c` | `cp/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/pwr_clk.c` | 480 MHz staged boot、CPU2 power-only、PSRAM owner 和 shutdown rollback |
34: | `cp/middleware/driver/sys_ctrl/sys_ps_driver.c` | `cp/middleware/driver/sys_ctrl/sys_ps_driver.c` | 单目标 DVFS 切换与错误/cache 传播 |
35: | `cp/middleware/soc/bk7258/hal/sys_hal.c` | `cp/middleware/soc/bk7258/hal/sys_hal.c` | bus divider bit 6、寄存器 readback 与失败恢复 |
36: | `cp/middleware/soc/common/hal/include/sys_hal.h` | `cp/middleware/soc/common/hal/include/sys_hal.h` | VDDD/VDDDIG readback API |
37: | `projects/app_ab/cp/config/bk7258/config` | `projects/app_ab/cp/config/bk7258/config` | app_ab CP 启用 OpenVela 480 MHz lifecycle |
38: | `projects/app_ab/partitions/bk7258/ram_regions.csv` | `projects/app_ab/partitions/bk7258/ram_regions.csv` | BK7258 640 KiB Share SRAM 和 16 MiB PSRAM 布局 |
39: 
40: UART0 bridge 保持 `MB_UART0` 唯一初始化 owner。AP 输出 LOG 模式保留 `ap0:`
41: 前缀、50 ms 半行刷新和有限重试；RAW 模式不改写字节。PC 到 AP 输入使用
42: 1024 B 有界 ring 和部分写 worker，所有物理 UART0 输出仍经 shell queue 串行化。
43: 
44: `ram_regions.csv`采用原厂 `lvgl/img_decode`、`lvgl/freetype_font` 的 16 MiB
45: 七区域布局：
46: 
47: ```text
48: 0x60000000..0x60700000  四个媒体 slab，共 7 MiB
49: 0x60700000..0x60720000  CP PSRAM heap，128 KiB
50: 0x60720000..0x60a00000  AP PSRAM heap，2.875 MiB
51: 0x60a00000..0x61000000  AP PSRAM section，6 MiB
52: ```
